text.name: Desert Storm Coalition
text.rules: Record "coalition victory". LIO spends 3 points. If LIO played this card, until the end of this turn, points spent by SAE count 1 less, never below 1. Raise Escalation by 1. If this card's event happens, remove it from the game afterwards.
text.history: Operation Desert Storm began on 17 January 1991 and ended with a ceasefire on 28 February 1991; a coalition of some 34 nations under a UN mandate expelled Iraqi forces from Kuwait.
